target.title: Sample 7 - repeat with a new lot of CaCO3

steps.title: First, a record a person wrote
steps.body: Thermoelectric sample 7 (a fictional study). Same conditions as sample 4, only the raw material lot changed, yet impurities appeared and it did not reproduce. This record is the only thing a person wrote; everything from here on was built by the AI

steps.title: A topic the AI built from the records
steps.body: A topic the AI raised after reading the records. Every key point ends with an @ back to its record, and points where the records disagree go under "Disagreements & open questions"

steps.title: A chat, recorded
steps.body: Asked "Why did samples 4 and 7 come out differently?", the AI answers from the sample records and the reading notes. Click a citation to open the source. To ask your own question, connect an AI in Settings
